files.description: Water gauge log (120 rows): gauge (gauge name such as "LA-01"), reading (meters, three decimals; about 3% empty), level (alert level, whole number from 3 to 80, no empty cells), site (dam, canal or lake; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent).

task_text: Readings taken at gauges whose alert level is above 60 are unreliable and must be treated as missing. After that, compute the mean reading per site (site names in lower case without extra spaces), rounded to three decimals. `result` should be a Series indexed by site.
intended_computation: Set reading to missing where level > 60 (24 rows), clean site (3 sites) and return the mean of the remaining readings per site, rounded to 3 decimals.

predicted_direction.reason: on 3.x the column-then-mask assignment is lost, so the unreliable readings stay in the means

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 in package TASKS_M1; task text, card, naive solution, reference and predicted direction were prepared there.
